family: NVIDIA Turing (sm_75): RTX 2060, RTX 2060 SUPER, Tesla T10
notes: f16 tensor-core prefill GEMM (cmma 16x16x16, f32 accumulate) is chosen by probing the runtime (Gpu::tensor_cores), not by profile. T10 prefill 1352 / 1736 / 1598 tok/s at 512 / 2048 / 8192 (docs/PREFILL_SPLIT.md G4 re-run); LB_NO_TC=1 is the A/B switch.
tiled (online-softmax) prefill attention is code, on for every card: lb-q4-gpu bb0f1cf (LFM2, 17-20x the per-query kernel on a P100), lb-qwen35 3771e5f (any prompt length up to ctx).
tensor-core stage width: one block per stage (default) 8584 / 10168 GFLOP/s vs LB_TC_STAGE2=1 7338 / 8775 on the T10 (docs/PREFILL_SPLIT.md).
LB_Q4_MATH stays f32: f16 and dp4a changed nothing measurable on RTX 2060 / 2060 SUPER (docs/WORK_TO_WEIGHTS.md X7a speed table).
not_measured: LB_PREFILL_UBATCH on the T10 with the qwen35 path
LB_QW_PREFILL_CHUNK (the 2060 holds 6 layers of the Qwen3.6 seat; the chunk there was set by the P100s)
